entries.title: Update every installation before opening a workspace
paragraphs: Opening a workspace in Situate 0.1.6 converts its conversation history to a format that requires 0.1.6 or later.

Update every installation that uses the workspace and back up the closed workspace before opening it. Do not reopen a converted workspace in an older version: it may open without recognizing the converted history. There is no reverse conversion.

entries.title: Search the web from chat
paragraphs: Search the public web and read page text from chat. Queries and page requests are sent to external services; pages that require JavaScript may not be readable.

entries.title: Load earlier messages when you need them
paragraphs: Long conversations load recent messages first, with earlier messages available on demand. Queued follow-up messages remain available when the assistant summarizes the conversation.

entries.title: Recover from interface errors
paragraphs: Depending on the error, you can reload the workspace, review a problem report or open a repair conversation.

entries.title: Read documents through custom plugins
paragraphs: Depending on the plugin, the assistant can browse document sources, search for documents and read their contents.

entries.title: Read bundled licenses and notices
paragraphs: Read, select and copy third-party license notices from About.

entries.title: File-system security update
paragraphs: Updated Rustix to address the disclosed memory-safety issue RUSTSEC-2026-0486.
